text:
Eleni (PM): dropped a compact diff-strip prototype for prompt-set rerun preview. PTAL for keyboard order, approval microcopy, and density. figma: https://figma.com/proto/diff-strip Tom (Design): I like the single-line diff strip per row. question: should expanding show a full side-by-side diff or an inline stacked diff? worried about vertical space. :thinking_face: Harper (Eng): perf note: rendering full diffs for hundreds of rows will tank the client. recommend virtualized list + on-demand render of the expanded diff. we can also precompute small PNG thumbnails on the server for the condensed view. Noah (QA): found a repro: Tab -> focuses the row, Tab again jumps to bulk actions instead of the diff. expected flow: Row (enter to expand) -> Diff -> Actions. also quick-approve shortcut currently opens a toast that steals focus. needs fix. Rae (Accessibility): accessibility asks: add a "Skip diffs" link at top, each diff region should be role="region" with aria-labelledby, and provide textual summary for severity (e.g., "critical regression"). delta chips must contain text not just color. Eleni (PM): microcopy pick: change primary CTA from "Approve run" to "Approve changes". when rows are selected show "Approve selection". disabled state tooltip: "select at least one sample to approve". keep phrases short. Tom (Design): visual idea: condensed diff line with a short excerpt and a small "expand" chevron. expanded state shows full inline stacked diff with input/output. also add patterned fills for regression markers for colorblind users. ensure 4.5:1 contrast for chips. Harper (Eng): implementation snippet for live summary:
Diffs: 5 regressions, 2 flakies
For condensed view we'll surface PNG thumbnails in a fallback and mount full DOM diff only on expand. estimate: 3 dev days + 1 QA day. Noah (QA): acceptance criteria I'll add: keyboard-only navigation (arrow/tab), Enter toggles expand, Esc collapses, quick-approve (cmd+shift+A) acts on selected rows, toasts do not steal focus, SR walkthroughs for NVDA/VoiceOver. Rae (Accessibility): I'll add suggested SR copy for diff thumbnails (offscreen): "diff preview: mostly stable, 1 regression" and verify aria-controls/aria-expanded on the expand button. also test high-contrast and pattern fills. Eleni (PM): great. next steps: Tom update frames with condensed+expanded states and aria labels, Harper to prototype virtualization + canvas thumbnails, Noah/Rae to draft acceptance tests. scheduling a 30-min sync tomorrow 9:30am PT. cc @ux-bot for checklist :white_check_mark: ux-bot: checklist created: [Updated frames], [Virtualization prototype], [A11y acceptance tests], [QA keyboard matrix]. Eleni (PM): thanks everyone — let's keep the first iteration focused (condensed thumbnails + expand) and avoid adding toggles. Tom (Design): will upload updated frames before the sync. Harper (Eng): will open a draft PR with canvas fallback and aria-live example. Noah (QA): will draft the keyboard and SR test cases and attach to the ticket. Rae (Accessibility): will review tests and provide SR copy tweaks.
